components_select_un: A minified helper function in the Filament select form component's bundled JavaScript.
components_select_yt: A minified helper function in the Filament select form component's bundled JavaScript.
components_select_ze: A minified helper function in the Filament select form component's bundled JavaScript.
components_viewinglist: PHP source file defining the ViewingList Livewire component in the real-estate-viewings-livewire module, which lists and manages property viewings.
components_viewinglist_viewinglist: Livewire component class that renders a paginated, searchable list of viewings for the current team and lets users confirm, cancel, or mark a viewing as a no-show.
concept_composer_installer_plugin: The liberusoftware/composer-installer Composer plugin, which installs liberu-module and liberu-theme packages into the tracked modules/ and themes/ directories.
concept_default_enabled: The module.json manifest field that determines whether a module boots by default, true for 37 of 40 modules and false for the three requiring third-party credentials.
concept_group_model: An Eloquent model used by the search functionality, referenced alongside reusable search scopes and SearchService in the search architecture docs.
concept_liberu_module_package: The liberu-module Composer package type used for domain packages under modules/, installed via the composer-installer plugin and described by a module.json manifest.
concept_messaging_web_interface: The Alpine.js-driven web UI for the private messaging system, kept separate from the Sanctum-authenticated API and protected by CSRF on state-changing requests.
concept_module_repo_first: The conformance principle (CONFORMANCE.md §3.1) that each package's own repository, not the host's modules/ tree, is the authoritative source of truth.
concept_notification_queueing: The pattern of dispatching notifications like ActivityNotification, FriendRequestNotification, and NewMessageNotification asynchronously via Laravel's ShouldQueue interface.
concept_phpstan_ratchet: The per-package PHPStan level ratchet that records each repository's measured static-analysis baseline in its tests.yml and only allows it to rise.
concept_search_scopes: Reusable Eloquent query scopes shared across models such as Group and Post to implement consistent, optimized search behavior.
concept_theme_helpers: Blade/PHP helper functions documented in THEME_QUICK_REFERENCE.md for working with the theme system, such as resolving active theme assets.
concept_theme_inheritance: The parent-chain mechanism, walked by ThemeManager::inheritanceChain(), by which public themes like default, dark, and clear-signal fall back to the shared base theme.
concept_theme_preference_persistence: The mechanism for storing a user's or site's chosen theme so it persists across requests, coordinated with SetLocale middleware and ThemeServiceProvider.
concept_theme_switcher_component: The Livewire component that lets a user switch the active theme in the UI, documented in the theme visual overview.
concept_theme_system: The set of liberu-theme Composer packages and their parent/child inheritance relationships that make up the application's theming system.
concept_tracked_installed_directories: The convention that modules/ and themes/ are Composer install targets that are also tracked in Git, so a fresh composer install can clobber tracked changes.
concept_zero_diff_gate: The CI check (CONFORMANCE.md §6.2) that fails the build if the tracked modules/themes tree diverges from what composer update would produce from the published packages.
config_filament_shield: Laravel config file (config/filament-shield.php) that configures the Filament Shield package, including the super-admin role name and deliberately-null tenant_model setting.
